map.和夏普区别？: How Does It Differ from Sharpe?
map.夏普用总 σ 罚所有波动，索提诺只用下行 σ 罚亏损波动；对不对称分布策略索提诺: Sharpe penalizes all volatility with the total σ, while Sortino penalizes only losing volatility with the downside σ; for strategies with asymmetric distributions Sortino fits better.
map.和夏普比率该如何选择？: How Do You Choose Between Sortino and Sharpe?
map.夏普比率用全部波动率，把上涨也一并算作风险；索提诺只用下行波动，更贴近投资者对「: Sharpe uses total volatility, counting gains as risk too; Sortino uses only downside volatility, which better matches investors' real feel about losses. For products whose returns are clearly right-skewed (often with outsized gains), Sortino is usually much higher than Sharpe.
